summary: Dick's Sporting Goods, Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 2.02, 8.01) reporting Q1 fiscal 2026 results and a quarterly dividend declaration. On May 26, 2026, the Board authorized a cash dividend of $1.25 per share on Common and Class B Common stock, payable June 26, 2026 to holders of record June 12, 2026. The earnings release shows 6% comp sales growth at the Dick's business and a return to growth at the recently acquired Foot Locker business. Non-GAAP EPS was $2.90, impacted by 9.6 million shares issued for the acquisition. This is a routine operational update with no special-situation event.
